cleared.check: Task 2, the new nested dispatch in evm2 7c9f3b6d crates/evm2/src/evm/mod.rs read line by line: fields at 250-264, enter_execution at 464-473, ExecutionGuard and its Drop at 1301-1324, execute_tx at 1399-1420, the inspected frame entry at 1951-1980, and State::clear_transaction_state at evm/state/mod.rs:564-580.
cleared.result: suspended_frames counts frames suspended under a transaction started while one runs and is used only by the assertion in set_initial_call_depth (1144). execute_tx takes current_frame, sets enclosing_refund to 0 and, when running was already true, tells the guard to put back the outer frame pointer and outer refund; Drop restores running, enclosing_refund, current_frame and the counter on return, on error and on unwinding. enclosing_refund only feeds Evm::tx_refunded for inspectors. Nothing in the new code touches the State: the transient map, journal, checkpoints, warm set and logs are the single State of the Evm, exactly as at 35aa3280 (execute_tx at old 1313-1322 only called enter_execution). A transaction dispatched while another runs therefore shares the outer transient map, and its discard or error path calls clear_transaction_state, which clears transient_storage, the journal, the prewarm set and logs of the outer transaction as well. That behaviour is unchanged by the release. It is not reachable on Tempo because no production caller dispatches a transaction while a user transaction runs (next entry).

No precompile, fee token handler, 0x76 batch call, keychain or configurable account path, inspector or block hook starts a transaction while a user transaction is on the stack. A precompile that calls out (Host::execute_message) opens a frame, which shares the transient map as a CALL does. With no caller, the three cases (shared map, cleared map, fresh committed map) do not arise on Tempo mainnet. cleared.result: The skip flag is set only when the T4 rule finds the remaining gas below the cold storage surcharge. account_with_skip then returns LoadError::ColdLoadSkipped for a cold account, which error.rs:169 maps to TempoPrecompileError::OutOfGas and the precompile halts out of gas; no value is returned. Currency.transfer reverts on failure (src/types/Currency.sol:54-86) and balanceOfSelf is a checked high level call (src/types/Currency.sol:90-95), so sync and settle (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, 349-364) revert and book nothing. cleared.check: Task 6 (L-1139), the 100 MiB per-frame memory limit and the changed EIP-7702 check. evm2 version/mod.rs:46-47 and 147, evm/config.rs:191-200, interpreter/runtime.rs:513; ethereum/mod.rs:432-450; Tempo tx gas cap in crates/hardfork/src/constants.rs:91 and lib.rs:319-323.
cleared.result: The memory limit applies per frame. Reaching 100 MiB needs 3,276,800 words, whose expansion cost 3w + w^2/512 is 20,981,350,400 gas, about 700 times the 30,000,000 transaction cap, so no hook or token frame can hit it before running out of gas, and the PoolManager sees the same failed call it would see for out of gas. The EIP-7702 change is in validate_sender_and_bump_nonce, which checks the transaction sender, not CALL setup; it only rejects a delegated sender when the EIP-7702 feature is off, which is not the case on Tempo's Prague based rules. A delegated account as hook (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134) or as native take recipient (src/types/Currency.sol:48) runs through the unchanged CALL path. The 575 cycle 26 cases were not rerun because their scripts are not on disk under that cycle's work directory.

cleared.result: The unit concerns Tempo's client release v1.19.2 and its evm2 pin only. No other network runs Tempo. Ethereum's reth nodes use evm2 at another revision (66687c18 per OPCODES.md), so the nested dispatch change has not reached them; nothing here bears on the other 20 networks.

leads.question: evm2 now documents and supports a transaction dispatched from inside a running one, but it shares the single State, so its discard or error path clears the outer transaction's transient map and journal. On every Tempo release, rerun scripts/callers.py of this unit against the pinned evm2 and tempo trees and confirm no precompile, handler, fee or keychain path calls transact, call_tx, system_call or execute_system_call while a user transaction runs.
leads.why: A single such caller reachable from a hook or token callback would reset IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT and NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT under an open unlock, and src/PoolManager.sol:112 would then accept unpaid debts.

leadResults.answer: The new code in evm2 7c9f3b6d execute_tx (evm/mod.rs:1399-1420) only saves and restores the frame pointer, an inspector refund counter and a counter of suspended frames; the transient map, journal, warm set and logs stay the one shared State, as before. No non-test caller in tempo c0c9372 starts a transaction while a user transaction runs (45 production lines, same as a9d6748). The live probe kept lock, count, synced currency, reserves and delta unchanged across 28 targets, now and under T14, on v1.19.2, and the battery, targeted, callsem, pmdiff, pmdiff2, scen28 and cycle 31 rollback sets match their v1.19.1 records.

A skipped cold account load returns LoadError::ColdLoadSkipped, mapped to OutOfGas (crates/precompiles/src/error.rs:169), so the TIP-20 call fails as a frame and the PoolManager's transfer or balanceOf reverts; no unloaded value reaches sync or settle. The skip only applies when remaining gas is below the cold surcharge. T15 has no activation time.

v1.19.2 pins evm2 7c9f3b6d and reth 5537d69 as expected, and the vector and script reruns match. The memory limit cannot be reached under the 30,000,000 gas cap (2.1e10 gas for 100 MiB) and the EIP-7702 change concerns the transaction sender only. The 575 delegated hook and native value cases of cycle 26 were not rerun because their scripts are not on disk.

v1.19.2 binaries are not published: download.tempo.xyz/binaries lists v1.19.1 as newest and the v1.19.2 paths return an index page. The pins in the lock are ruint 1.21.1 and evm2 7c9f3b6d, and the instruction, analysis and storage files of evm2 are byte equal to 35aa3280, so the source level reruns hold; the binary relift waits for the archives.
